steps.procedure_text: 在20℃下将5.1％盐酸1165g加入到四口瓶中，滴加3-氯-2-甲基苯胺100g，滴加完毕后，在0℃进一步滴加20％NaNO2水溶液251.41g，滴加过程中控温不超过-5～10℃，搅拌，得到重氮盐溶液。称量20％CH3SNa水溶液273g和32％NaOH水溶液26.62g置于另一四口烧瓶中，将上述重氮盐溶液滴加到此烧瓶中，通过高效液相色谱监测反应。反应完成后，用盐酸调节至pH为2～3，分层，收集有机层，蒸馏，得到式(VI)化合物。
steps.procedure_summary: 3-Chloro-2-methylaniline is diazotised with aqueous sodium nitrite in aqueous hydrochloric acid, and the resulting diazonium salt solution is added to aqueous sodium methanethiolate and sodium hydroxide, giving the aryl methyl sulfide of formula (VI) after acidification, layer separation and distillation.
steps.notes: A0 estimated one step and this record agrees: the section is a single continuous operation with no workup between the diazotisation and the displacement, so it is one record with is_one_pot true. The document prints no N-marker headings inside this example, so step_label is assigned as Step 1. Per the one-pot rule the temperature is taken from the final transformation, the addition of the diazonium salt solution to the CH3SNa and NaOH flask, and no temperature is printed for it, so temperature is not_specified. The temperatures the text does print all belong to the first transformation and are kept on the relevant compounds' addition profiles: 20 degrees C for the hydrochloric acid charge and the aniline addition, 0 degrees C for the start of the NaNO2 addition, and control not exceeding -5 to 10 degrees C during that addition. Two four-necked flasks are used; no volume is printed for either. The text says stirred but does not say by what, so the stirring type is left null. Several charges are masses of solutions rather than of solutes: 5.1% hydrochloric acid, 20% aqueous NaNO2, 20% aqueous CH3SNa and 32% aqueous NaOH. Every mass_g here is the printed mass of the solution; no solute mass was computed. steps.procedure_summary: The compound of formula (VI) is dissolved in dichloromethane and brominated by dropwise addition of bromine at low temperature. After HPLC shows complete conversion the mixture is quenched with aqueous sodium hydroxide, the organic phase is washed with aqueous sodium hydroxide and then water, and the solvent is stripped to give the compound of formula (I).

No reaction time is printed; the endpoint is set by HPLC. The starting material of formula (VI) is the product of Example 1. steps.procedure_summary: Sodium hydride and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol are combined in anhydrous tetrahydrofuran at low temperature to form the trifluoroethoxide in situ, and a tetrahydrofuran solution of the compound of formula (III) is then added dropwise under temperature control. After the reaction is judged complete by HPLC the mixture is quenched with water, the organic phase washed with brine and concentrated, and the residue recrystallised to give the compound of formula (IV).
steps.notes: One numbered example, one record, matching A0's estimate of one step. Treated as one pot: the alkoxide is generated in situ and the benzylic bromide is added to the same flask with no workup between the two transformations, so reaction_class is taken from the final O-alkylation. Temperature is taken from that final transformation, 不超过15℃ (not above 15 C) during the addition of 式(III)化合物, which is an upper bound only and so is recorded as a range with no lower limit; the -5 to 5 C printed earlier belongs to the sodium hydride and trifluoroethanol charge and is kept in those compounds' addition_profile. The prose states 将60％氢化钠9.2g溶于80mL无水四氢呋喃中, that the sodium hydride was dissolved in tetrahydrofuran; sodium hydride does not dissolve in tetrahydrofuran, and the wording is transcribed as printed rather than corrected. The drawn scheme on line 478 agrees with the prose on the transformation and on both structures, but gives CF3CH2ONa over the arrow, a pre-formed sodium trifluoroethoxide the prose never names, while the sodium hydride and trifluoroethanol the prose does charge appear nowhere on the arrow: hence reagent_drawn_not_written and reagent_written_not_drawn. CF3CH2ONa is carried in compounds as a drawing-only reagent and is deliberately absent from reactant_names, which follows the prose. No product mass and no yield are printed, only the melting point 80-82℃, so no mass balance can be computed. The reactant 式(III)化合物 is the section product of Example 4 under the identical A1 identifier and the identical drawn SMILES, so the link is by compound identity. Example 4 prints two alternative preparations of that same compound, labelled 方法1 and 方法2, and either could have supplied this charge; precursor_step names the first, Example 4::Method 1, and linkage_confirmed is true, with Example 4::Method 2 recorded here as an equally valid precursor that the document does not distinguish between. 搅拌 records that the mixture was stirred without naming a stirrer type, so stirring.type is null. No atmosphere, reaction time, reactor or pressure is stated. Tetrahydrofuran is charged in three separate portions and each is carried as its own compounds[] entry with its own printed volume and its own addition_profile: the portion the sodium hydride is taken up in, the portion carrying the trifluoroethanol added dropwise to it, and the portion carrying the 式(III)化合物 solution added dropwise last. The patent prints no combined charge and none is summed here, so recording a single entry would have had to pick one portion and drop the other two.

steps.procedure_text: 向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物40g、水20g、三乙胺26.49g、PdCl2催化剂0.4g、配体1,3-双(二苯基膦)丙烷3.95g、溶剂四氢呋喃400g，抽真空，氮气置换，以约1～4MPa的压力通入CO，在80℃反应约12h。通过高效液相色谱监测反应完成后，过滤，旋蒸除去溶剂四氢呋喃，加入甲醇溶解，调酸至pH为2～3，析出白色固体，过滤，滤饼经水洗、打浆后过滤，得到式(V)化合物，收率67.57％，熔点155-157℃。
steps.procedure_summary: The formula (IV) aryl bromide is hydroxycarbonylated in an autoclave with carbon monoxide and water over a palladium chloride catalyst with a bis(diphenylphosphino)propane ligand, triethylamine as base and tetrahydrofuran as solvent. After the solvent is stripped the residue is taken up in methanol, acidified, and the precipitated white solid is filtered, water washed and slurried to give the formula (V) carboxylic acid.
steps.notes: One step, matching the A0 estimate of one. Palladium catalysed hydroxycarbonylation of the formula (IV) aryl bromide with carbon monoxide and water; the class list has no carbonylation entry, so reaction_class is other_cross_coupling, the same value Example 6 carries for the identical transformation. The starting material 式(IV)化合物 is the section product of Example 5 under the identical A1 identifier and the identical drawn SMILES, so the charge is matched by compound identity; precursor_step is Example 5::Step 1 and linkage_confirmed is true. Pressure is recorded as an elevated condition with the printed range in qualitative_text, not as a quantity. The drawn scheme immediately above the procedure shows the same single arrow, the same aryl bromide reactant, H2O and CO on the arrow and the carboxylic acid product, and so agrees with the prose; nothing is flagged. The autoclave is 高压釜; no stirrer is named, so stirring type is left null. No isolated mass is printed, only a yield percentage, so no mass balance arithmetic is available to contradict. Melting point of the product is reported in the text and carried on the A1 compound record. Reaction class across the carbonylations of this document: Examples 6 and 7 are the same transformation of the same substrate under CO, differing only in the phosphine ligand and the solvent, and Examples 9, 10 and 11 carbonylate the same aryl bromide as well. The class list has no carbonylation entry, so one value is chosen and used for all of them, other_cross_coupling: every one of them replaces a C-Br bond on an arene by a new carbon-carbon bond over a palladium/phosphine catalyst, which is the cross-coupling family, and other is reserved for transformations that fit no family at all. Using other for one of a matched pair and other_cross_coupling for the other would make two examples of one procedure look like two different reactions. Example 10 is the exception: it is one-pot and rule 5 takes its class from the final transformation, the rearrangement, not from its carbonylation stage.

The reaction temperature and time are the only ones printed. The drawn scheme immediately above the step agrees with the prose: one arrow, the formula (IV) bromide as sole drawn reactant, H2O and CO on the arrow, and the formula (V) benzoic acid as product; nothing is flagged. The class list has no carbonylation entry, so one value is chosen and used for all of them, other_cross_coupling: every one of them replaces a C-Br bond on an arene by a new carbon-carbon bond over a palladium/phosphine catalyst, which is the cross-coupling family, and other is reserved for transformations that fit no family at all. Using other for one of a matched pair and other_cross_coupling for the other would make two examples of one procedure look like two different reactions. Example 10 is the exception: it is one-pot and rule 5 takes its class from the final transformation, the rearrangement, not from its carbonylation stage.

After the solvent is removed, the residue is taken up in methanol and acidified to precipitate the benzoic acid of formula (V), which is filtered, water washed and slurried.
steps.notes: One step, matching A0's estimate of 1: a single charge, one transformation and one workup. Palladium-catalysed hydroxycarbonylation of the aryl bromide of formula (IV) with CO and water to the benzoic acid of formula (V); no listed reaction_class names carbonylation, so other_cross_coupling is used for the Pd-catalysed replacement of the C-Br bond. Pressure is recorded as a condition (elevated, about 1 to 4 MPa) and not as a quantity, and the qualitative text carries the printed range because no single kPa value is stated. The reaction temperature and time are the only ones printed. The drawn scheme immediately above the step agrees with the prose: one arrow, the formula (IV) bromide as sole drawn reactant, H2O and CO on the arrow, and the formula (V) benzoic acid as product; nothing is flagged. The compound of formula (IV) is the section product of Example 5 under the identical A1 identifier 式(IV)化合物 and the identical drawn SMILES, so the charge is matched by compound identity; precursor_step is Example 5::Step 1 and linkage_confirmed is true. This section's HPLC conditions are separately referred back to Example 5 as well. No isolated product mass is printed, only the yield and the melting point, so no mass balance can be checked against a printed mass. Reactor volume is not given. A stirrer is not mentioned, so stirring is left null. The 1H and 13C NMR are referred to as Figures 11 and 12 and carry no printed data. Reaction class across the carbonylations of this document: Examples 6 and 7 are the same transformation of the same substrate under CO, differing only in the phosphine ligand and the solvent, and Examples 9, 10 and 11 carbonylate the same aryl bromide as well. The class list has no carbonylation entry, so one value is chosen and used for all of them, other_cross_coupling: every one of them replaces a C-Br bond on an arene by a new carbon-carbon bond over a palladium/phosphine catalyst, which is the cross-coupling family, and other is reserved for transformations that fit no family at all. Using other for one of a matched pair and other_cross_coupling for the other would make two examples of one procedure look like two different reactions. Example 10 is the exception: it is one-pot and rule 5 takes its class from the final transformation, the rearrangement, not from its carbonylation stage.

The two examples are alternative preparations of the same acid and the document does not say which batch this charge came from, so precursor_step names the first of them, Example 6::Step 1, with Example 7::Step 1 an equally valid precursor recorded here; linkage_confirmed is true because the identifiers match, not because the sections are near each other. The text says explicitly 上述制备的式(VII)化合物, the compound of formula (VII) prepared above, so the link to Step 1 is confirmed by the text and not by name similarity. Room temperature is the stirring temperature and the ice bath applies only to the dropwise addition, so it is recorded as cooling_method and in the addition profiles rather than as the step temperature. The step charges 0.5 g of the dione but no mass for the acid chloride, which is carried through from the 1.5 g of the formula (V) compound charged in Step 1; scale is taken from that carried-through charge. The workup reads 旋蒸除去溶剂，得到式(V III)化合物的溶液, that is, the solvent is stripped and yet the product is described as a solution; recorded as printed. Line 512 spells the label 式(V III)化合物 with a space inside the numeral while line 514 spells it 式(VIII)化合物; A1 keeps the spaced form as an alias and the unspaced identifier is used here. Arrow 2 of the scheme on line 510 draws cyclohexane-1,3-dione over the arrow and gives the same product, but the machine read of that arrow carries no triethylamine and no solvent, both of which the prose states, hence reagent_written_not_drawn. No yield is printed for this step. Line 516 states the HPLC conditions are the same as in Example 5; that cross-reference is located and not reproduced here. The formula (VIII) ester is spelled several ways across this document: 式(VIII)化合物 (used on line 514 and by this section's A1 record, and so used as the identifier here), 式(V III)化合物 with a space inside the numeral on line 512, 式(VIII)的酯化合物 and 式(VIII)的中间体酯化合物 in the summary of the invention, 式(VIII)酯中间体 in the heading of Example 9, and (VIII)酯化合物 in the body of Example 9, which is the identifier A1 uses for that section. They all name the same enol ester of 1,3-cyclohexanedione, and a reader joining the two examples should treat 式(VIII)化合物 here and (VIII)酯化合物 in Example 9 as one compound.

steps.notes: Acetone cyanohydrin catalysed rearrangement of the enol ester of formula (VIII) to the C-acylated triketone, tembotrione. Classed as acylation because the net change is transfer of the aroyl group from the enol oxygen to C-2 of the dione ring; the taxonomy offers no rearrangement class, hence medium confidence, and the rearrangement is carried in the tags. mechanism_type is catalytic because the sub-stoichiometric cyanohydrin drives it; the acyl transfer itself is ionic. The text says 上述得到的式(VIII)化合物溶液, the solution of the compound of formula (VIII) obtained above, so the link to Step 2 is confirmed by the text. The Chinese product is 环磺酮, tembotrione. An earlier machine translation of these lines rendered it as sulcotrione, which is the different herbicide 磺草酮; the Chinese is authoritative and the English on line 515 was corrected during this run. The pH is printed as a range 2 to 3 and workup.ph_target holds a single number, so the range is kept in the workup narrative and the field left null rather than a bound invented. No product mass is printed, only the yield, and no charge is printed for this step; the scale is taken from the 1.5 g of the formula (V) compound charged in Step 1 and carried through unisolated. The 76.59% yield is stated for this step only. Arrow 3 of the scheme on line 510 shows the same enol ester going to the same triketone, but the vision pass could not read the reagent over that arrow and recorded it as illegible; that is an unread label, not a disagreement with the prose, so no drawing_text_conflict and no reagent_written_not_drawn is raised. steps.notes: A0 estimated one step and this record agrees: the section is a single continuous operation with no workup between the diazotisation and the displacement, so it is one record with is_one_pot true. The document prints no N-marker headings inside this example, so step_label is assigned as Step 1. Per the one-pot rule the temperature is taken from the final transformation, the addition of the diazonium salt solution to the CH3SNa and NaOH flask, and no temperature is printed for it, so temperature is not_specified. The temperatures the text does print all belong to the first transformation and are kept on the relevant compounds' addition profiles: 20 degrees C for the hydrochloric acid charge and the aniline addition, 0 degrees C for the start of the NaNO2 addition, and control not exceeding -5 to 10 degrees C during that addition. Two four-necked flasks are used; no volume is printed for either. The text says stirred but does not say by what, so the stirring type is left null. Several charges are masses of solutions rather than of solutes: 5.1% hydrochloric acid, 20% aqueous NaNO2, 20% aqueous CH3SNa and 32% aqueous NaOH. Every mass_g here is the printed mass of the solution; no solute mass was computed. The pH 2 to 3 adjustment is a workup operation, so it is recorded in the workup narrative; workup.ph_target is left null because the text gives a range and picking a bound would invent a number. The IMAGE_EXTRACT reaction scheme immediately before the procedure agrees with the prose on the reactant (3-chloro-2-methylaniline), on the reagents NaNO2, CH3SNa and HCl, and on the product being an aryl methyl sulfide bearing chloro and methyl, which is what the prose calls the compound of formula (VI). The one difference is that the 32% aqueous NaOH charged with the CH3SNa appears in the prose but on no arrow, so reagent_written_not_drawn is raised; it is most likely drawing shorthand rather than a substantive conflict, and no drawing_text_conflict is raised because nothing in the scheme contradicts the procedure. The Chinese runs across a page break at the head of line 433, where the OCR emitted a stray token None before 过-5～10℃; that token is not part of the patent text and is excluded from procedure_text. No product mass, no product yield and no purity are printed anywhere in the section, so no mass balance can be checked and none is asserted. HPLC is used both for in-process monitoring and, in the following paragraph, with full instrument conditions; only the monitoring use is a process control here. 1H and 13C NMR are reported only as references to Figures 1 and 2, with no shift data. Linkage: this is the first step of the synthesis and nothing earlier in the document produces its starting material, so precursor_step is null. Its product is recorded here with the A1 identifier for this section, the English 'compound of formula (VI)'; Example 2 charges the same compound under the Chinese identifier 式(VI)化合物, which is the A1 identifier for that section. The two are the same substance, the label (VI) is the document's own, and the SMILES the drawings give for both is the same aryl methyl sulfide, so Example 2 links back to this step by identity and not merely by adjacency.

The arrow carries only Br2 while the prose also names dichloromethane as solvent and sodium hydroxide for the quench and washes; that is ordinary scheme abbreviation rather than a disagreement, so no reagent flag is raised. Temperature is printed as 10℃左右, i.e. approximately 10 C, and it is the only temperature given, so it is recorded as the step temperature as well as in the bromine addition profile. No reaction time is printed; the endpoint is set by HPLC. The starting material of formula (VI) is the product of Example 1. A1 records that product under the English identifier 'compound of formula (VI)' and records the reactant here under the Chinese identifier 式(VI)化合物; the two spellings name one substance, the label (VI) is the document's own, and the drawings give the same SMILES for both, so this is an identity match and not an inference from the sections being adjacent. precursor_step is therefore Example 1::Step 1 and linkage_confirmed is true. steps.procedure_text: 向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物56.84g、三乙胺37.95g、PdCl2催化剂0.4g、配体1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷3.98g、溶剂1,4-二氧六环300g，抽真空，氮气置换3次，以约1～4MPa的压力通入CO，在80～85℃反应约8h后降温至70℃，加入2g丙酮氰醇，继续反应5h。通过高效液相色谱监测反应完成后，降至室温，卸去压力，打开反应釜，过滤，除去三乙胺氢溴酸盐，旋蒸除去溶剂二氧六环，加入甲醇水溶解，用氢氧化钠溶液调节pH至8～9，加热至50℃搅拌，过滤掉不溶物，调酸至pH为2～3，析出白色固体，将溶液冷却到室温并冰浴搅拌0.5h，过滤，水洗，过滤，60℃干燥，得到黄白色粉末状固体环磺酮，收率64.67％，熔点120～122℃。
steps.procedure_summary: In one pot, the aryl bromide of formula (IV) is carbonylated under CO pressure over a palladium chloride catalyst with a bisphosphine ligand and triethylamine in dioxane, and the resulting ester is rearranged in the same vessel by adding acetone cyanohydrin without isolation. The triethylamine hydrobromide by-product is filtered off, the solvent stripped, and tembotrione recovered by dissolving in aqueous methanol, basifying, filtering off insolubles and reprecipitating with acid.
steps.notes: A0 estimated 2 steps for this section; this record is 1. The section carries no numbered step markers at all: it is a single continuous paragraph headed 一锅法 (one-pot method), and the two transformations A0 counted are the carbonylative esterification of 式(IV)化合物 with CO and the subsequent acetone-cyanohydrin-promoted rearrangement of that ester to tembotrione. There is no workup between them - the batch is only cooled from 80-85 C to 70 C and the acetone cyanohydrin is added to the same pot - so rule 5 makes it one record with is_one_pot true and the two transformations listed in one_pot_steps. reaction_class and the temperature are taken from the final transformation, per rules 5 and 9, so the structured temperature and time are the 70 C and 5 h of the rearrangement. Both stages are nonetheless recoverable from this record: one_pot_steps carries each stage in document order with its own conditions, the first stage running at 80 to 85 C for about 8 h under CO at about 1 to 4 MPa and the second at 70 C for 5 h after the acetone cyanohydrin was added, and conditions.pressure and the CO and acetone cyanohydrin addition profiles say which stage each belongs to. Reaction class: the carbonylation stage here is the same transformation that Examples 6, 7, 9 and 11 record as other_cross_coupling, but this record is one-pot and rule 5 assigns the class from the final transformation, so the class is acylation for the rearrangement and the carbonylation is carried in one_pot_steps and in the tags instead. Linkage: 式(IV)化合物 is the section product of Example 5 under the identical A1 identifier and the identical drawn SMILES, so the charge is matched by compound identity rather than by the sections being near each other; precursor_step is Example 5::Step 1 and linkage_confirmed is true. Drawing: the scheme on line 535 has one arrow, 式(IV)化合物 to tembotrione, and its conditions list CO, cyclohexane-1,3-dione and acetone cyanohydrin. Reactant, product and two of the three drawn reagents agree with the prose. Cyclohexane-1,3-dione is drawn on the arrow but never written in this section's procedure, which is why reagent_drawn_not_written is raised; it is chemically required for the drawn product and is carried as a reactant with no quantity. That single arrow also corroborates treating the paragraph as one record. Translation: 环磺酮 is tembotrione. The vision pass originally rendered it as sulcotrione (磺草酮) on these lines; the English was corrected during this run and the Chinese is authoritative, so no translation_conflict is raised. 丙酮氰醇 is acetone cyanohydrin, not cyanoacetone.
